candidates.title: Defer Sign-In to Post-Adoption
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to occur after pet selection and certificate creation, right before waiting screen.
candidates.why: Sign-in has high early drop-off (72.9%) and delays time-to-value; letting users pick their pet first increases investment before asking for sign-in.

guard.reason: Deferring sign-in to post-adoption is an allowed reordering of onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drops 27.1% early; reordering defers friction to increase setup investment, but requires architectural workflow changes.

lessons_next: Predictions were consistently too high across all tests, as none produced statistically significant improvements.
Adding new screens (such as desktop controls quick-guides before finish) showed no clear effect.
Updating sign-in copy with cloud save security details showed no clear effect.
Adding photo quality hints during adoption upload showed no clear effect.
Adding wait progress and time estimate indicators on the home screen showed no clear effect.
